brief: Prioritise Glenmoor Reach for pre-event attention ahead of the forecast heat event, as its advanced age and loading history reduce its margin against mechanical failure [MG-023]. Inspect and clear any encroaching vegetation or obstructions around the radiator banks and ventilation openings, as clearance work takes precedence over other remedial activity [SOP-011]. If this ageing unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023].
